# WeddingPlanner

> WeddingPlanner (weddingplanner.ge) is a Georgian wedding planning platform: a free planning tool for couples, a catalog of wedding venues and services in Georgia, online invitations with RSVP, and planning advice in Georgian.

WeddingPlanner არის ქართული პლატფორმა ქორწილის დასაგეგმად: უფასო ხელსაწყო წყვილებისთვის, საქორწილო სივრცეებისა და მომსახურებების კატალოგი საქართველოში, ონლაინ მოსაწვევები დასწრების დადასტურებით და რჩევები ქართულად.

The site is in Georgian, with an English interface. Using the service is currently free. It's run by Swich Solutions. Contact: info@weddingplanner.ge

## For couples

- [Wedding planning tool](https://weddingplanner.ge/planning): a task list by stage, budget, guest list, seating on the venue's floor plan, and the wedding day schedule
- [Online invitations](https://weddingplanner.ge/invitations): 14 designs, a personal link and QR code per family, replies land in the guest list
- [Wedding day schedules](https://weddingplanner.ge/ganrigebi): example timelines for three kinds of wedding day
- [Venues and services](https://weddingplanner.ge/vendors): wedding venues, photographers, decor, music, cakes and more in Georgia

## Advice (in Georgian)

- [Blog](https://weddingplanner.ge/rchevebi/blogi): practical wedding planning articles

## For vendors

- [List your business](https://weddingplanner.ge/for-vendors): a free profile for wedding venues and services
